patch_description: Replace the stub that returns all-zero points (which are collinear, giving min triangle area 0) with a deterministic construction that: (1) initializes 11 points from a fixed-seed generator inside the equilateral triangle (vertices included), (2) runs a projected gradient-free optimization using scipy's SLSQP on barycentric coordinates (u,v) with u≥0, v≥0, u+v≤1, so every iterate stays feasible inside the container, and (3) maximizes a smooth soft-minimum of all 165 triangle areas with an annealed inverse-temperature parameter beta, which approximates the true minimum-area objective and escapes poor local minima. Multiple fixed seeds are tried and the configuration with the best exact minimum triangle area is returned. All failure paths fall back to a valid initial configuration, guaranteeing a feasible (11,2) output. The optimization is fully deterministic and runs in a couple of seconds, which is secondary to quality per the metrics.
